extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia readers and editors (contributors of biographies of living persons)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and requirements for writing or editing a Wikipedia biography of a living person, focused on verifiability and removal of unsourced contentious material. Applies to contributors adding content or citations to BLP (biography of living persons) articles.

rubrics_metrics.name: This section needs additional citations for verification
rubrics_metrics.description: This section of a biography of a living person needs additional citations for verification. Please help by adding reliable sources.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Find sources: "Stephen Colbert" – news · newspapers · books · scholar · JSTOR. (Template urging editors to add citations and indicating the article needs reliable sourcing.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Removal of unsourced or poorly sourced contentious material
rubrics_metrics.description: Contentious material about living persons that is unsourced or poorly sourced must be removed immediately from the article and its talk page, especially if potentially libelous.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Editors should remove unsourced or poorly sourced contentious material immediately; prioritize removal when material could be libelous. Use reliable, verifiable sources when restoring or adding contentious claims.
